title: Lecture 3 Part 1 — Foundations
description: Foundations questions on CSS syntax, selectors, colors, text properties, the cascade, and validation.
subject: Web Development

questions.question: What does CSS stand for?
questions.explanation: CSS is short for Cascading Style Sheets, the language used to describe the presentation of documents such as HTML pages.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an advantage of using CSS?
options: It creates potentially smaller HTML documents.
It requires a server-side database to function.
It allows for easier site maintenance.
questions.correctAnswer: It requires a server-side database to function.
questions.explanation: CSS works in the browser without a server-side database; databases are not a requirement for styling a page.

questions.question: In the CSS rule `h1 { color: blue; }`, what is `h1` considered?
questions.explanation: In a CSS rule, h1 is the selector because it identifies which elements receive the declaration.

questions.question: Which CSS property configures the text color (foreground color) of an element?
questions.explanation: The color property sets an element’s foreground/text color; background-color controls its background.

questions.question: Which CSS property configures the background color of an element?
questions.explanation: background-color sets the area behind an element’s content, while color sets the foreground text color.

questions.question: Which type of style sheet is coded directly within the HTML `<body>` using the `style` attribute?
questions.explanation: An inline style is written on an individual HTML element with its style attribute.

questions.question: Embedded (Internal) styles are defined within which HTML tag?
questions.explanation: Internal or embedded CSS rules are written inside a <style> element, commonly placed in the document head.

questions.question: Which HTML element is used to associate an external style sheet with a web page?
questions.explanation: <link rel="stylesheet" href="…"> connects an HTML document to an external CSS file.

questions.question: How is a CSS Class selector defined in a style sheet?
questions.explanation: A class selector begins with a period and matches elements carrying that class in their class attribute.

questions.question: How is a CSS Id selector defined in a style sheet?
questions.explanation: An id selector begins with # and targets the element whose id matches that selector.

questions.question: Which of the following is a recommended unit for `font-size` to ensure better accessibility and scaling?
questions.explanation: em sizes text relative to its context, so it can scale with user or inherited font-size settings more readily than a fixed pixel value.

questions.question: Which property is used to change the typeface of text?
questions.explanation: font-family chooses the typeface used to render text; fallback families can be listed after it.

questions.question: Which HTML element defines an inline section on a web page that is not physically separated from other areas (unlike a `<div>`)?
questions.explanation: <span> is an inline container, so it can style part of a text flow without creating a new block.

questions.question: What does the "Cascade" refer to in CSS?
options: The way images load from top to bottom.
The rules of precedence determining which styles override others when there is a conflict.
The folder structure of CSS files on a server.
The animation effects applied to text.
questions.correctAnswer: The rules of precedence determining which styles override others when there is a conflict.
questions.explanation: The cascade resolves competing declarations using precedence rules, including origin, importance, specificity, and source order.

questions.question: According to the CSS rules of precedence, which type of style has the highest priority?
questions.explanation: Among the style types listed here, an inline declaration takes precedence over ordinary external and embedded declarations for the same property.

questions.question: Which CSS property modifies the appearance of text with an underline, overline, or line-through?
questions.explanation: text-decoration controls lines such as underline, overline, and line-through.

questions.question: What does the `line-height` property configure?
options: The total height of the webpage.
The spacing allowed for the line of text (e.g., double-spacing).
The length of a horizontal rule (`<hr>`).
questions.correctAnswer: The spacing allowed for the line of text (e.g., double-spacing).
questions.explanation: line-height sets the height of a line box and therefore controls the vertical spacing between lines of text.

questions.question: What is the standard hexadecimal color value for white?
questions.explanation: #FFFFFF has the maximum red, green, and blue values, producing white in hexadecimal RGB notation.

questions.question: How many colors are in the Web-Safe Color Palette?
questions.explanation: The classic web-safe palette contains 216 colors, formed from the combinations of six levels for each RGB channel.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the W3C CSS Validation Service?
options: To check Cascading Style Sheets for syntax errors.
To host external style sheets for free.
To convert HTML files to CSS files.
questions.correctAnswer: To check Cascading Style Sheets for syntax errors.
questions.explanation: The W3C CSS validator checks stylesheets for syntax and conformance problems; it does not host or convert them.
